data.name: Clifton
data.detailed_description:
Clifton is an open-world survival game set on a remote tropical island. Explore, survive its dangers, and find a way to escape before the island’s unresolved mysteries find you. Play alone or in online co-op with up to 4 players.

WELCOME TO CLIFTON ISLAND

A storm forces your group to take shelter on a remote tropical island.
By morning, your guide is dead, your boat has been destroyed on the rocks, and the forest hides a presence that does not want to let you leave. To get home, you will have to survive, explore, and find a way out.

SURVIVE THE ISLAND

Clifton is a paradise island, but you will soon discover that it is a hostile environment to overcome. Keep an eye on your health and hunger, search for food, resources, and useful tools, and carefully decide how far to venture from the safety of your shelter. Every expedition may give you what you need to move forward, but it also exposes you to new dangers.

YOU ARE NOT ALONE

The island is inhabited by killers who know the territory and will do everything they can to take you out. You must discover who they are, why they are there, and why they want to kill you.
Every killer is different and unique: some chase you, others watch, set traps, or strike from a distance. To stay alive, you must understand when to fight, when to run, and when to change your path.

FIND A WAY OUT

The boat you arrived on will not take you home. Find a way to contact the outside world, prepare a boat at the main dock, or discover another way to send a signal beyond the island. Every escape requires preparation, resources, and the courage to face areas you would rather avoid.

ALONE OR TOGETHER

Face Clifton alone or in online co-op with up to 4 players. Explore together, divide the tasks, and do whatever it takes to leave the island alive.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 3100 or Intel Core i3-10100F
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce GTX 1660
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5600X or Intel Core i5-12400F
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce RTX 3060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
